title: Billing Excess Wear on a Returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Vehicle
content:
Once a vehicle financed under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract has come back under the return option and the return inspection is on file, the excess wear charge is billed on the contract.

## Which returns the rule governs

The excess wear charge rule governs the excess wear charge billed on a returned balloon contract of a customer who holds at most one active Kestrel lease, at most one active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract and at most one Kestrel new-vehicle retail contract at paid in full or closed, and only that charge. The wear assessed recorded by the return inspection remains the amount the charge starts from.

| Customer's holdings | Position |
|---|---|
| At most one of each of the three kinds above | Within this rule and its tool |
| Two or more active Kestrel leases, two or more active Kestrel new-vehicle retail contracts, or two or more Kestrel new-vehicle retail contracts at paid in full or closed | Outside this rule and its tool; the excess wear charge stays under the excess wear clause of the vehicle return rule |
| No return inspection on file | Outside this rule and its tool until one is recorded |

The rest of the return rule, including the mileage and return fee provisions, the return window and the billing timing, stays as the vehicle return rule states it.

## `bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4`

**Capability.** One call books one return charge entry of type `excess_wear_charge` on the balloon contract, dated today, for the amount given, and adds that amount to the contract's fees due. After it, the excess wear charge stands billed on the contract and appears both in the posting history and in the fees due balance.

**Invocation.** Agent-side: the agent unlocks `bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4` and calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `balloon_contract_id` — the reference number of the balloon contract being billed, as returned by the balloon contract lookup for the verified customer; an id string.
- `amount` — the excess wear charge to bill, in USD, a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent, with no currency symbol; it is booked exactly as given.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the new charge entry reference, the charge type `excess_wear_charge`, the amount billed in USD with 2 decimal places, the billing date in YYYY-MM-DD form and the contract's fees due balance in USD with 2 decimal places including the charge. Receiving it means the charge is booked.
